How does my favorite driver get points in 1997?
Each driver in every division is not only racing each week to win their own race, but
oftentimes is looking to better themselves in the "points race." In most cases each
week, money is awarded to drivers that compete in the evening program by how many
points they accumulate that night. Heat wins are worth fewer points than feature races.
Here's how it works:
Example. A Late Model heat winner is awarded 8 points and 4th in the feature
would gain an additional 40 points!
